mapper.select: SELECT id, supplier_id, part_id, unit_price, lead_days, valid_from, valid_to, status, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, version FROM supplier_quote WHERE deleted = 0 AND part_id = #{partId} AND status = 1 AND valid_from <= CURDATE() AND valid_to >= CURDATE() ORDER BY unit_price ASC, lead_days ASC, id ASC
